title: no abbr expand on first mention
name: No abbr; expand on first mention — GOLD
rule: Don’t use `<abbr>`; expand on first mention. Screen-reader support for `<abbr>` is limited. Write “Australian Football League (AFL)” then “AFL”. Dual-cite Canada abbreviations (widest-audience test); GOLD names the element ban + first-mention pattern.
pass_when: First mention is expanded with the short form in parentheses; later mentions use the short form; no `<abbr>`.
fail_when: `<abbr>` is used, or the short form appears first with no expansion.
overview: Do not use abbr; expand the term on first mention, then use the short form.
apply_when: Body copy introduces abbreviations or acronyms for users.
not_when: Already-expanded short forms used after a proper first mention.
agent_hint: Expand on first mention with short form in parentheses; never use <abbr>.
description: Don’t use `<abbr>`; expand on first mention. Screen-reader support for `<abbr>` is limited. Write the full phrase with the short form in parentheses, then use the short form later — for example “Australian Football League (AFL)” then “AFL”. Dual-cite Canada abbreviations (widest-audience test); GOLD names the element ban plus first-mention pattern. Pass when first mention is expanded, later uses short form, and there is no `<abbr>`; fail when `<abbr>` is used or the short form appears first with no expansion.
do_not_claim: Canada widest-audience abbreviations as a merge that drops the `<abbr>` ban.
